mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate environment, as indicated by FEDFUNDS below 0.5%, compresses the risk-free rate and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% from the prior month signals robust consumer spending, which is associated with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and an increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to the prior month indicates a strengthening labor market, which typically precedes higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The joint behavior of these two series is more predictive than either series alone.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions (as indicated by high industrial production growth and low unemployment), a rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals sustained economic momentum and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime (defined by INDPRO growth > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE < 4.0%), INDPRO increases do not lead to positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST above 500,000 units) indicates strong residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 500,000 units.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.0% signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 99.0%, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a monthly decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals a strengthening labor market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a UNRATE decline > 0.1pp fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of instances.
